moment.place: A dark indoor hallway with a scuffed black floor and Atlassian banners
moment.summary: The phone, held sideways, looks down a long dark hallway with a black floor and a metal grille along one side. It turns to show a purple Atlassian banner and a larger Atlassian backdrop, then back down the hallway, where two people stand near a blue sign. No speech was recorded.
moment.title: Hallway with Atlassian banner
